name: sihi_pump_simulation
title: SIHI pump simulation from dimensionless polynomials
summary: Example simulation of a SIHI pump. Cubics of the flow coefficient give the dimensionless head and absorbed-power coefficients, and the affinity-law definitions return the pressure rise and the shaft power. Water enters only through the suction density.
